episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Aboard a falling plane as the clock ticks toward doom, Han Tae Sul puts his famous mind to work for a solution. Kang Seo Hae arrives in the year 2020.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The contents of a mysterious suitcase give Tae Sul more questions than answers. In exchange for lottery numbers, Sun agrees to help Seo Hae

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Tae Sul's presentation at a conference gets a violent interruption. He and Seo Hae make a narrow escape, but more trouble soon follows.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: On the run from the enforcement agency, Tae Sul and Seo Hae give in to the time traveler's request that they make a stop at his mother's house.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Caught by Kim Seo-jin trespassing in her clinic, Tae-sul tries to explain what's going on. Seo-hae reveals disturbing details about the future.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seo-hae infiltrates Eddy Kim's party with a mission. After a series of distressing events, Tae-sul realizes he cannot trust everyone around him.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Seo Hae urges Sun to flee the country, and asks Mr. Park to do her a favor in exchange for an item he's eager to get his hands on.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Despite Seo Hae's insistence that he lie low, Tae Sul focuses on tracking down an enigmatic figure who seems to be tied to everything.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: At the amusement park with Tae Sul for her birthday, Seo Hae encounters someone unexpected. A familiar threat strikes again.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Tae Sul enters enemy quarters to retrieve Seo-hae. Learning she's been put in a dire condition, he turns to a grudging Mr. Park for assistance

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Tae Sul and Sigma come face-to-face. In order to rescue Seo Hae, Tae Sul must endure an emotional trip through his past.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: When Seo-hae wakes up, a person she missed is waiting to meet her. A long-forgotten childhood memory returns to Tae-sul.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Tae-sul is reunited with a trusty friend, who comes to him with a warning. A suitcase containing disturbing contents arrives at Asia Mart.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: With the war looming on the horizon, everyone must make their choices. When Seo-hae heads to the only place she knows, Tae-sul finds her.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: As Tae-sul tries to locate him, Sigma reveals more details about himself. Sun frees Seo-hae from the bunker.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Tae-sul asks Seo-hae to trust him no matter what happens — and demonstrates that nothing is fixed when it comes to matters of the future.
